result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but there is a clear data-formatting bug (€NaN delivery fee) plus several layout/consistency problems in the horizontal carousel and card overlays.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a numeric delivery fee, exposing a broken value/parsing error to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate the fee value before formatting; fall back to '€0 delivery' or hide the label when the value is null/NaN.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right screen edge and its title 'Trattoria Piccol…' is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis or padding, making the carousel look clipped rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding to the scroll container and apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis so the peeking card reads as intentional.

issues.description: The pizza card under 'Popular right now' is abruptly cut by the bottom tab bar with no visible title, rating or fade, so the card appears broken rather than partially scrolled.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards scroll fully clear of the navigation.

issues.description: Favourite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button background and icon colour across all cards.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' omit rating/cuisine metadata that 'Popular right now' cards show, creating an inconsistent information hierarchy.
issues.suggestion: Include the same core metadata (rating, cuisine) on all restaurant cards or intentionally define a compact variant.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' row uses light grey on white, likely below 4.5:1 contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colour to meet WCAG AA contrast.
